notes.text: Aholiab " Father's tent". He was of the tribe of Dan. Ultimately Israel would be designated as "Dan to Beersheba". (see Judges 20:1; 1 Samuel 3:20; 2 Samuel 3:10; 1 Kings 4:25) Beersheba is on the southernmost border of Judah's territory. The Lord is calling two individuals to supervise a tabernacle (the father's tent 'Aholiab') that will govern the entire tribes 'from Dan to Beersheba'.

notes.text: Elder Russell M. Nelson explained: "Now I understand that my behavior on the Sabbath is my sign to the Lord of my regard [respect and love] for him and for the covenant under which I was born. If … my interests on the Sabbath were turned to pro football games or worldly movies, the sign from me to him would clearly be that my devotion would not favor the Lord. If, on the other hand, my Sabbath interests were focused on the Lord and his teachings, my family, or the sick, or the poor, and the needy, that sign would likewise be visible to God" (The Power within Us [Salt Lake City: Deseret Book Co., 1988], 127).

_November 13_.--About 4 o'clock a. m. I was awakened by Brother Davis
knocking at my door, and calling on me to arise and behold the signs
in the heavens. I arose, and to my great joy, beheld the stars fall
from heaven like a shower of hailstones; a literal fulfilment of the
word of God, as recorded
